pullback_100_5.name: Uptrend dip (100d, RSI2<5)
pullback_100_5.desc: The stock is above its 100-day average (long-term uptrend) but dropped sharply in the last 2 days (2-day RSI below 5). Buy the dip.

pullback_100_10.name: Uptrend dip (100d, RSI2<10)
pullback_100_10.desc: The stock is above its 100-day average (long-term uptrend) but dropped sharply in the last 2 days (2-day RSI below 10). Buy the dip.

pullback_200_5.name: Uptrend dip (200d, RSI2<5)

pullback_200_10.name: Uptrend dip (200d, RSI2<10)
pullback_200_10.desc: The stock is above its 200-day average (long-term uptrend) but dropped sharply in the last 2 days (2-day RSI below 10). Buy the dip.

breakout_20_1.name: 20-day breakout
breakout_20_1.desc: The price closes above its highest price of the last 20 days, while above its 200-day average.

breakout_20_1.5.name: 20-day breakout + volume
breakout_20_1.5.desc: The price closes above its highest price of the last 20 days on volume 1.5x normal or more, while above its 200-day average.

breakout_55_1.name: 55-day breakout
breakout_55_1.desc: The price closes above its highest price of the last 55 days, while above its 200-day average.

breakout_55_1.5.name: 55-day breakout + volume
breakout_55_1.5.desc: The price closes above its highest price of the last 55 days on volume 1.5x normal or more, while above its 200-day average.

macross_10_30.name: 10/30 average crossover
macross_10_30.desc: The 10-day average price crosses above the 30-day average: a new uptrend may be starting.

macross_20_50.name: 20/50 average crossover
macross_20_50.desc: The 20-day average price crosses above the 50-day average: a new uptrend may be starting.

macross_50_200.name: 50/200 average crossover
macross_50_200.desc: The 50-day average price crosses above the 200-day average: a new uptrend may be starting.

rsi_30_any.name: RSI back above 30
rsi_30_any.desc: The 14-day RSI climbs back above 30 after being below it (the selling is easing).

rsi_30_trend.name: RSI back above 30 in uptrend
rsi_30_trend.desc: The 14-day RSI climbs back above 30 after being below it (the selling is easing), while the stock is above its 200-day average.

rsi_40_any.name: RSI back above 40
rsi_40_any.desc: The 14-day RSI climbs back above 40 after being below it (the selling is easing).

rsi_40_trend.name: RSI back above 40 in uptrend
rsi_40_trend.desc: The 14-day RSI climbs back above 40 after being below it (the selling is easing), while the stock is above its 200-day average.

macd_below0.name: MACD cross below zero
macd_below0.desc: The MACD line crosses above its signal line while still below zero: momentum turning up after a fall.

macd_trend.name: MACD cross in uptrend
macd_trend.desc: The MACD line crosses above its signal line while the stock is above its 200-day average.

engulfing.name: Bullish engulfing
engulfing.desc: After a short dip, a green candle fully covers the previous red candle, while above the 50-day average.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.desc: After a short fall, a candle with a long lower wick: sellers pushed the price down but buyers pushed it back up. Stock is above its 200-day average.

support_20.name: 20-day support bounce
support_20.desc: The price dips to its 20-day low area (support) and closes strongly higher, while above its 200-day average.

support_50.name: 50-day support bounce
support_50.desc: The price dips to its 50-day low area (support) and closes strongly higher, while above its 200-day average.

volspike_2.name: Volume spike 2x
volspike_2.desc: Trading volume is 2x normal or more and the price rises 3% or more, above the 50-day average: big buyers may be stepping in.

volspike_3.name: Volume spike 3x
volspike_3.desc: Trading volume is 3x normal or more and the price rises 3% or more, above the 50-day average: big buyers may be stepping in.

high52.name: New 52-week high + volume
high52.desc: The price closes at its highest level of the past year (252 trading days), on volume 1.5x normal or more. Stocks at yearly highs often keep going, because sellers who bought higher are gone.

squeeze.name: Squeeze breakout
squeeze.desc: The Bollinger Bands (20 days, 2 standard deviations) were the narrowest in 6 months within the last week (a very quiet stock), and today the price closes above the upper band, above its 50-day average.

bb_bounce.name: Back above lower band in uptrend
bb_bounce.desc: The price closed below the lower Bollinger Band (an unusually big drop) and today closes back above it, while above its 200-day average.

nr7_break.name: Quiet day, then close above
nr7_break.desc: Yesterday's high-to-low range was the narrowest of the last 7 days, and today the price closes above yesterday's high, above its 50-day average.

inside_break.name: Inside day, then close above
inside_break.desc: Yesterday's whole range fit inside the day before (an inside day), and today the price closes above that bigger day's high, above its 50-day average.

ema_pullback.name: Pullback to 20-day EMA
ema_pullback.desc: In a strong uptrend (price above a rising 50-day average, which is above the 200-day), the price dips to its 20-day exponential average and closes back above it on a green candle.

trend_template.name: Leader breakout (trend template)
trend_template.desc: A market leader's chart: price above its 50-, 150- and 200-day averages in that order, the 200-day rising, at least 30% above its yearly low and within 25% of its yearly high. Buy when it closes above its 20-day high on volume 1.5x normal or more.

supertrend.name: Supertrend turns up
supertrend.desc: The Supertrend indicator (10 days, 3x the average daily range) flips from down to up, while above the 200-day average.

adx_cross.name: Strong trend turns up (ADX)
adx_cross.desc: The ADX shows a strong trend (above 25) and the +DI line crosses above the -DI line: buyers take over.

gap_hold.name: Gap up 3% that holds
gap_hold.desc: The stock opens 3% or more above yesterday's close, closes above its open (the gap held), on volume 2x normal or more, above its 50-day average. Often news-driven buying that continues.

w_breakout.name: Weekly breakout
w_breakout.desc: On the weekly chart, the week closes above the highest price of the last 20 weeks, on above-normal weekly volume, above the 40-week average. Checked each Friday.

w_rsi50.name: Weekly RSI turns up
w_rsi50.desc: On the weekly chart, the 14-week RSI climbs back above 50 while the price is above its 30-week average. Checked each Friday.

strength_top5.name: Top 5 strongest (monthly)
strength_top5.desc: At each month-end, the 5 stocks that rose the most over the last 6 months (not counting the latest month), among those above their 200-day average.

strength_top10.name: Top 10 strongest (monthly)
strength_top10.desc: At each month-end, the 10 stocks that rose the most over the last 6 months (not counting the latest month), among those above their 200-day average.

Stocks at yearly highs often keep going, because sellers who bought higher are gone. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

high52@calm.name: New 52-week high + volume + Calm market
high52@calm.desc: The price closes at its highest level of the past year (252 trading days), on volume 1.5x normal or more. Stocks at yearly highs often keep going, because sellers who bought higher are gone. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

high52@world.name: New 52-week high + volume + World rising
high52@world.desc: The price closes at its highest level of the past year (252 trading days), on volume 1.5x normal or more. Stocks at yearly highs often keep going, because sellers who bought higher are gone. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

squeeze@nifty.name: Squeeze breakout + Nifty rising
squeeze@nifty.desc: The Bollinger Bands (20 days, 2 standard deviations) were the narrowest in 6 months within the last week (a very quiet stock), and today the price closes above the upper band, above its 50-day average. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

squeeze@calm.name: Squeeze breakout + Calm market
squeeze@calm.desc: The Bollinger Bands (20 days, 2 standard deviations) were the narrowest in 6 months within the last week (a very quiet stock), and today the price closes above the upper band, above its 50-day average. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

squeeze@world.name: Squeeze breakout + World rising
squeeze@world.desc: The Bollinger Bands (20 days, 2 standard deviations) were the narrowest in 6 months within the last week (a very quiet stock), and today the price closes above the upper band, above its 50-day average. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

bb_bounce@nifty.name: Back above lower band in uptrend + Nifty rising
bb_bounce@nifty.desc: The price closed below the lower Bollinger Band (an unusually big drop) and today closes back above it, while above its 200-day average. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

bb_bounce@calm.name: Back above lower band in uptrend + Calm market
bb_bounce@calm.desc: The price closed below the lower Bollinger Band (an unusually big drop) and today closes back above it, while above its 200-day average. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

bb_bounce@world.name: Back above lower band in uptrend + World rising
bb_bounce@world.desc: The price closed below the lower Bollinger Band (an unusually big drop) and today closes back above it, while above its 200-day average. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

nr7_break@nifty.name: Quiet day, then close above + Nifty rising
nr7_break@nifty.desc: Yesterday's high-to-low range was the narrowest of the last 7 days, and today the price closes above yesterday's high, above its 50-day average. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

nr7_break@calm.name: Quiet day, then close above + Calm market
nr7_break@calm.desc: Yesterday's high-to-low range was the narrowest of the last 7 days, and today the price closes above yesterday's high, above its 50-day average. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

nr7_break@world.name: Quiet day, then close above + World rising
nr7_break@world.desc: Yesterday's high-to-low range was the narrowest of the last 7 days, and today the price closes above yesterday's high, above its 50-day average. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

inside_break@nifty.name: Inside day, then close above + Nifty rising
inside_break@nifty.desc: Yesterday's whole range fit inside the day before (an inside day), and today the price closes above that bigger day's high, above its 50-day average. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

inside_break@calm.name: Inside day, then close above + Calm market
inside_break@calm.desc: Yesterday's whole range fit inside the day before (an inside day), and today the price closes above that bigger day's high, above its 50-day average. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

inside_break@world.name: Inside day, then close above + World rising
inside_break@world.desc: Yesterday's whole range fit inside the day before (an inside day), and today the price closes above that bigger day's high, above its 50-day average. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

ema_pullback@nifty.name: Pullback to 20-day EMA + Nifty rising
ema_pullback@nifty.desc: In a strong uptrend (price above a rising 50-day average, which is above the 200-day), the price dips to its 20-day exponential average and closes back above it on a green candle. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

ema_pullback@calm.name: Pullback to 20-day EMA + Calm market
ema_pullback@calm.desc: In a strong uptrend (price above a rising 50-day average, which is above the 200-day), the price dips to its 20-day exponential average and closes back above it on a green candle. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

ema_pullback@world.name: Pullback to 20-day EMA + World rising
ema_pullback@world.desc: In a strong uptrend (price above a rising 50-day average, which is above the 200-day), the price dips to its 20-day exponential average and closes back above it on a green candle. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

trend_template@nifty.name: Leader breakout (trend template) + Nifty rising
trend_template@nifty.desc: A market leader's chart: price above its 50-, 150- and 200-day averages in that order, the 200-day rising, at least 30% above its yearly low and within 25% of its yearly high. Buy when it closes above its 20-day high on volume 1.5x normal or more. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

trend_template@calm.name: Leader breakout (trend template) + Calm market
trend_template@calm.desc: A market leader's chart: price above its 50-, 150- and 200-day averages in that order, the 200-day rising, at least 30% above its yearly low and within 25% of its yearly high. Buy when it closes above its 20-day high on volume 1.5x normal or more. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

trend_template@world.name: Leader breakout (trend template) + World rising
trend_template@world.desc: A market leader's chart: price above its 50-, 150- and 200-day averages in that order, the 200-day rising, at least 30% above its yearly low and within 25% of its yearly high. Buy when it closes above its 20-day high on volume 1.5x normal or more. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

supertrend@nifty.name: Supertrend turns up + Nifty rising
supertrend@nifty.desc: The Supertrend indicator (10 days, 3x the average daily range) flips from down to up, while above the 200-day average. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

supertrend@calm.name: Supertrend turns up + Calm market
supertrend@calm.desc: The Supertrend indicator (10 days, 3x the average daily range) flips from down to up, while above the 200-day average. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

supertrend@world.name: Supertrend turns up + World rising
supertrend@world.desc: The Supertrend indicator (10 days, 3x the average daily range) flips from down to up, while above the 200-day average. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

adx_cross@nifty.name: Strong trend turns up (ADX) + Nifty rising
adx_cross@nifty.desc: The ADX shows a strong trend (above 25) and the +DI line crosses above the -DI line: buyers take over. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

adx_cross@calm.name: Strong trend turns up (ADX) + Calm market
adx_cross@calm.desc: The ADX shows a strong trend (above 25) and the +DI line crosses above the -DI line: buyers take over. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

adx_cross@world.name: Strong trend turns up (ADX) + World rising
adx_cross@world.desc: The ADX shows a strong trend (above 25) and the +DI line crosses above the -DI line: buyers take over. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

gap_hold@nifty.name: Gap up 3% that holds + Nifty rising
gap_hold@nifty.desc: The stock opens 3% or more above yesterday's close, closes above its open (the gap held), on volume 2x normal or more, above its 50-day average. Often news-driven buying that continues. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

gap_hold@calm.name: Gap up 3% that holds + Calm market
gap_hold@calm.desc: The stock opens 3% or more above yesterday's close, closes above its open (the gap held), on volume 2x normal or more, above its 50-day average. Often news-driven buying that continues. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

gap_hold@world.name: Gap up 3% that holds + World rising

w_breakout@nifty.name: Weekly breakout + Nifty rising
w_breakout@nifty.desc: On the weekly chart, the week closes above the highest price of the last 20 weeks, on above-normal weekly volume, above the 40-week average. Checked each Friday. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

w_breakout@calm.name: Weekly breakout + Calm market
w_breakout@calm.desc: On the weekly chart, the week closes above the highest price of the last 20 weeks, on above-normal weekly volume, above the 40-week average. Checked each Friday. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

w_breakout@world.name: Weekly breakout + World rising
w_breakout@world.desc: On the weekly chart, the week closes above the highest price of the last 20 weeks, on above-normal weekly volume, above the 40-week average. Checked each Friday. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

w_rsi50@nifty.name: Weekly RSI turns up + Nifty rising
w_rsi50@nifty.desc: On the weekly chart, the 14-week RSI climbs back above 50 while the price is above its 30-week average. Checked each Friday. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).

w_rsi50@calm.name: Weekly RSI turns up + Calm market
w_rsi50@calm.desc: On the weekly chart, the 14-week RSI climbs back above 50 while the price is above its 30-week average. Checked each Friday. Only taken when India VIX, the market's fear gauge, is below 20.

w_rsi50@world.name: Weekly RSI turns up + World rising
w_rsi50@world.desc: On the weekly chart, the 14-week RSI climbs back above 50 while the price is above its 30-week average. Checked each Friday. Only taken when the US S&P 500 is above its 200-day average (world markets are rising).

strength_top5@nifty.name: Top 5 strongest (monthly) + Nifty rising
strength_top5@nifty.desc: At each month-end, the 5 stocks that rose the most over the last 6 months (not counting the latest month), among those above their 200-day average. Only taken when the Nifty 50 index is above its 200-day average (the Indian market is rising).
